summary: Busy Swann Road kerb with houses 8-10 m away along its whole length.
reasons: Bus Zone sign on the stretch

best_section.where: Mid-stretch beside the houses and driveways on the north side

drivers.seclusion: Houses 8-10 m from the kerb at every point; lots of homes on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane on a wide road; a Bus Zone sign sits 13 m off the line.
drivers.convention: Two or three cars parked along the stretch, not a parking lane.

sun_shade: Open; scattered street trees shade parts from the south.
